newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Charter may ease Australia jobless - Evans.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Charter may ease Australia jobless - Evans.

text.p: Australian Treasury Secretary Ted Evans said on Thursday the government's charter of budget honesty could help ease unemployment.
"It is not claimed that this legislation will solve all of our economic ills, it won't solve unemployment ... it may indirectly contibute towards that," Evans told a Senate committee hearing.
Evans did not say how the charter, which forces the government to present six-monthly reports on its budget and the economy, would affect unemployment and he did not provide any further details.
The upper house committee is examining the legislation implementing the charter.
Official data released on Thursday showed Australia's unemployment rate rose to 8.8 percent, seasonally-adjusted, in February from 8.6 percent in January.
